latest.raw:
We’re seeing fantastic engagement on Track 1 with  many hitting a top score! 
Exactly what we’d hope for on a foundational track designed to confirm your pipeline can recover a clinically confirmed answer.

But the leaderboard is only part of the story. Your methods write-up counts just as much. Two perfect scores can look very different once we read how each team got there.

Knowing the variant is only half of the story. Track 2, figuring out whether an existing medication could help, is where the biggest unmet need still lives. 
Come put that same energy there!!
